site.name: Aladdin Mine
site.componentDetail: Named historic gold mine shown on Keystone topographic mapping
overview: Aladdin Mine is a named historic mine locality in Summit County shown on the Keystone topographic quadrangle north of Keystone and near the Montezuma mining area. The mapped mine locality is approximately 39.60749, -105.90446.

Mineral-locality records identify Aladdin as a past-producing gold mine with additional reported base-metal and silver occurrences. Remnant uses the mapped mine locality for identification only and does not claim that a surviving opening is accessible or safe.
